cards.gloss_en: a case for holding the blade of a sword or knife
cards.ex_en: He slid the sword back into its scabbard.
cards.ex_cn: 他把剑滑回鞘里。

cards.gloss_en: small spears thrown by hand as weapons
cards.ex_en: The hunters threw sharp darts at the deer.
cards.ex_cn: 猎人向鹿投出锋利的标枪。

cards.gloss_en: set something on fire; started it burning
cards.ex_en: She kindled a small fire with dry grass.
cards.ex_cn: 她用干草点起一小堆火。

cards.gloss_en: the wish to harm or hurt other people
cards.ex_en: He spoke without any malice in his heart.
cards.ex_cn: 他说话时心里没有一点恶意。

cards.gloss_en: not seen or noticed by anyone
cards.ex_en: He watched them from an unseen corner.
cards.ex_cn: 他在一个看不见的角落观察他们。

cards.gloss_en: to hide something so it is not found
cards.ex_en: She tried to conceal the letter in her bag.
cards.ex_cn: 她想把信藏在包里。

cards.gloss_en: great energy and strength
cards.ex_en: He worked with great vigour all morning.
cards.ex_cn: 他整个上午都干劲十足地工作。

cards.gloss_en: rough, cruel, and like an animal
cards.ex_en: Their brutish manners frightened the child.
cards.ex_cn: 他们粗野的举止吓坏了孩子。

cards.gloss_en: to upset or anger someone
cards.ex_en: I did not mean to offend you.
cards.ex_cn: 我并不想冒犯你。

cards.gloss_cn: (古)大胆的、勇猛的;耐寒的、结实的
cards.gloss_en: bold and daring (old sense); also tough
cards.ex_en: These hardy plants survive the cold winter.
cards.ex_cn: 这些耐寒的植物能熬过寒冬。

cards.gloss_en: gathering up courage to do something
cards.ex_en: Plucking up courage, she knocked on the door.
cards.ex_cn: 她鼓起勇气敲了门。

cards.gloss_en: a piece of burning wood used as a torch
cards.ex_en: He held up a firebrand to light the cave.
cards.ex_cn: 他举起火把照亮山洞。

cards.gloss_en: a hollow space or hole inside something
cards.ex_en: A small cavity in the rock kept the water.
cards.ex_cn: 岩石里的一个小洞存住了水。

cards.gloss_en: causing a sick, disgusted feeling
cards.ex_en: The rotten fish gave off a nauseous smell.
cards.ex_cn: 烂鱼发出令人作呕的气味。

cards.gloss_en: made used to a place or way of life
cards.ex_en: After years abroad he felt naturalised to the town.
cards.ex_cn: 在国外多年后他已适应了这座小镇。

cards.gloss_en: to see or make out something with effort
cards.ex_en: I could just discern a boat in the fog.
cards.ex_cn: 我在雾中勉强辨认出一条船。

cards.gloss_en: burned with a bright, strong flame
cards.ex_en: The dry wood blazed brightly in the night.
cards.ex_cn: 干木头在夜里熊熊燃烧。

cards.gloss_en: to break a hole in something, esp. wood
cards.ex_en: The rocks could stave a hole in the boat.
cards.ex_cn: 礁石可能会把船撞出一个洞。

cards.gloss_en: strong and full of eager feeling
cards.ex_en: He had an ardent wish to go home.
cards.ex_cn: 他有一个回家的强烈愿望。

cards.gloss_en: resting or lying down quietly
cards.ex_en: He spent the night reposing in his tent.
cards.ex_cn: 他在帐篷里休息了一夜。

cards.gloss_en: steps taken in advance to avoid harm
cards.ex_en: They took precautions against the storm.
cards.ex_cn: 他们采取措施防备暴风雨。

cards.gloss_en: unusual and remarkable
cards.ex_en: It was an act of singular kindness.
cards.ex_cn: 这是一件非凡的善举。

cards.gloss_en: arguments or disagreements
cards.ex_en: The two brothers often had small disputes.
cards.ex_cn: 两兄弟经常有些小争执。

cards.gloss_en: not tied up; freed from bonds
cards.ex_en: The prisoner stood there with hands unbound.
cards.ex_cn: 那囚犯双手松开地站在那里。

cards.gloss_en: a warm sandy-brown colour
cards.ex_en: The lion has a smooth tawny coat.
cards.ex_cn: 狮子有一身光滑的黄褐色皮毛。

cards.gloss_en: caught sight of something at a distance
cards.ex_en: From the hill he espied a distant ship.
cards.ex_cn: 他从山上望见了一条远处的船。

cards.gloss_en: the act of giving in to another's power
cards.ex_en: He bowed his head in complete submission.
cards.ex_cn: 他低下头,完全顺从。

cards.gloss_en: signs or marks that show something
cards.ex_en: The footprints were tokens of a visitor.
cards.ex_cn: 那些脚印是有人来过的迹象。

cards.gloss_en: walls and works built for defence
cards.ex_en: The soldiers built strong fortifications on the hill.
cards.ex_cn: 士兵们在山上筑起坚固的防御工事。

cards.gloss_en: to spit and speak in a quick, broken way
cards.ex_en: He began to sputter with anger.
cards.ex_cn: 他气得开始语无伦次地喷着唾沫说话。

cards.gloss_en: the priests and ministers of a religion
cards.ex_en: The clergy led the prayers in the church.
cards.ex_cn: 神职人员在教堂里领着祷告。

cards.gloss_en: in a loving, tender way
cards.ex_en: She smiled affectionately at her son.
cards.ex_cn: 她深情地对儿子微笑。

cards.gloss_en: something made known, esp. by God
cards.ex_en: The old book brought him a great revelation.
cards.ex_cn: 那本旧书给了他极大的启示。

cards.gloss_en: feeling sorry for having done wrong
cards.ex_en: The penitent boy said sorry to his mother.
cards.ex_cn: 悔过的男孩向母亲道了歉。

cards.gloss_en: to nourish; figuratively to foster (a feeling)
cards.ex_en: Good food helps to nourish the body.
cards.ex_cn: 好的食物有助于滋养身体。

suspect.ctx: no savage, had he been at the mouth of it, would be so hardy as to venture in
suspect.issue: 书中 so hardy as to venture in = 大胆到敢冒险进去,取古义"大胆的、有胆量的";现释义"能吃苦的/耐寒的"回读不通,完全对不上
suspect.suggest: 增补"(古)大胆的、有胆量的"义项

suspect.ctx: I could find nothing to nourish my suspicion
suspect.issue: 书中 nourish my suspicion = 助长/滋生(疑心),抽象喂养情绪;现释义"滋养、养育(身体/孩子)"偏窄,盖不到"助长(念头、疑心)"
suspect.suggest: 增补"助长、使滋生(情绪/念头)"义项
